title.narrative: Safe Trade Kenya Country Programme -Standards, Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary Interventions (COVID-19)

description.narrative: The project aims at supporting the application of relevant standards, technical regulations and SPS measures to facilitate safe trade during the COVID-19 emergency. On the one hand the project will support enterprises to produce and supply safe medicaments, personal protective equipment and food that meet requisite standards or SPS requirements. On the other hand, the project supports standards and SPS regulatory authorities to ensure PPE, medical and food supplies conform to meet health, and safety requirements defined in health and safety standards, guidelines, and protocols.
The provided cumulative expenditure figures excludes the related overhead and project management costs for the period from 2023/01/31 to 2023/03/31
